notes: 39.2.15 is built directly from validated 39.2.11. Builds 39.2.12, 39.2.13 and 39.2.14 are explicitly rejected and are not functional bases.
The only functional UI change is a CSS-only Math Core grid-attached visual plane used while the Math Core is detached in native Dessus/top mode.
The Math Core geometry, preferred 520-760 px detached width, drag, resize, native Dessus/Latéral/Réduire controls, runtime and business content remain exactly the 39.2.11 behavior.
No external backdrop DOM node, ResizeObserver, MutationObserver, geometry widening or descendant measurement is introduced.
The grid-attached plane is scoped to #math only and cannot become a Market Snapshot or Graphique window overlay.

Window layout storage intentionally remains erith_admin_portal_39_2_9; if a rejected 39.2.12 geometry was previously persisted, the existing RESET FENÊTRES control can clear that operator layout state.
No market, chart, Atlas, NØX, Aerith, Memory, Bridge, Ollama, WebSocket, timer or business-state behavior is changed by this build.
